tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search live startup job listings, newest first. Returns compact job summaries without the full description. The free tier covers the last 14 days of listings; full access unlocks the archive and posted_before.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Fetch a single job listing by id, including the full description and the startup.jobs URL where applications are made.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Fetch a company profile by slug, including its startup.jobs URL and live listing count.

tools.name: get_company_jobs
tools.description: List all live job listings for one company (no recency window), newest first. Returns compact summaries without full descriptions.

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List roles from the role taxonomy (title, slug, parent_slug). Returns the most common roles by default, the roles whose title matches q, or the roles directly under parent. At most 100 roles are returned; total is how many matched. The slugs are the values the role filter of search_jobs, job_trends,

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List countries with jobs (name, ISO country code). The codes are the values the country filter of search_jobs, job_trends, and salary_benchmarks accepts.

tools.name: job_trends
tools.description: Job posting volume trends on startup.jobs, optionally filtered by role and/or country. The free tier returns a 12-month summary with year-over-year change; full access unlocks the monthly time series (up to 36 months).

tools.name: salary_benchmarks
tools.description: Salary benchmarks (yearly, USD) computed from startup.jobs listings that disclose compensation, optionally filtered by role and/or country. The free tier returns an aggregate over the last 12 months; full access unlocks the monthly time series and company-level benchmarks.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
